db:select.doc:name: Get Total Employee Count
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM first_project.employee

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var totalRecords = (payload[0].total default 0) as Number var limit = (vars.limit default 1) as Number var totalPages = ceil(totalRecords / limit) as Number --- if (totalPages > 0) (0 to (totalPages - 1)) else []
